defaults.input_src: close; source input is unused by signal calculations

exact_signal_equations.shadow_size: if close>open then high-close else close-low
exact_signal_equations.zero_range: No source guard; division undefined on flat candle. Strict bullish/bearish tests also false; do not fill shadow percentage to manufacture entries.
exact_signal_equations.geometry_note: Only upper shadow for bullish bars and lower shadow for bearish bars is constrained; the opposite wick is not restricted. Do not replace with symmetric marubozu definition.

entry_price_capture.timing: Under default closedbar calculation/nextbaropen fills, a new long is observed at fillbar CLOSE and captures fillbar OPEN. It is not assigned at signalclose or pending-order submission.
entry_price_capture.long_from_flat: Capture on first calculation seeing positive size increase
entry_price_capture.short_to_long_reversal: Capture on first calculation seeing size increase from negative to positive, if one open trade
entry_price_capture.short_from_flat: No capture because negative position size does not exceed previouszero size
entry_price_capture.after_exit: Most recent long capture remains in series until another bought condition
entry_price_capture.important_port_rule: Preserve raw fillbarOPEN reference for longexit even if declared slippage makes actual executionprice differ. Substituting actualfill would change source rule.

order_lifecycle.entry_type: Market; no limit orstop entry price provided
order_lifecycle.close_type: Market for matching currently open entryID
order_lifecycle.fill_default: Earliest next available tick; historical market orders normally nextbaropen
order_lifecycle.reversal: Opposite strategy.entry automatically closes existing position and opens new opposite exposure
order_lifecycle.disabled_price_orders: Both TP/SL price series are na at source defaults; a port must not create any price barrier or activate optional percentages
order_lifecycle.native_nan_call_caveat: Source unconditionally calls strategy.exit with both price argumentsna when optionsdisabled. Native v5 runtime treatment not executed here; a mathematical port can omit absent-price orders explicitly, but cannot claim unchanged native runtime success.
order_lifecycle.same_bar_entry_and_close: While already long, qualifying bullish geometry can coincide with longclose condition; same-side entry is suppressed by pyramiding0 and close remains active. Whileflat, close(Long) targets no open Long trade; do not treat it as cancelling a pending new entry. Native parity fixture remains required.
order_lifecycle.gap_risk: A signalclose exceeding entry reference by0.2% does not ensure profitable nextopenfill; no stop orholding-time limit exists by default

sizing.native_intention: 10% of strategy equity per new position; do not substitute100%equity or3%risk sizing
sizing.port_budget_proposal: Freeze10%ofpreorderstrategy-equity quote budget and fee-reservedcash constraint; define whether quantity converts atactualfill or fixedsignalclose. Either execution convention requires declaration, not an unstated native sizing claim.
sizing.reversal_fee_note: Native reversal transacts oldpositionclose plus newpositionentry; Spot cash-only port removes newshort leg and must account closefees
